Package com.leap.leaplaughlove.iam.auth

Class AuthService

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.iam.auth.AuthService
@Service public class AuthService extends Object
Service for handling authentication logic, including login and account lock management. Provides methods for authenticating clients and managing failed login attempts.

      public AuthService(ClientRepository clientRepository, ClientCredentialsRepository credentialsRepository, org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder, JwtService jwtService, ClientSessionRepository sessionRepository, StaffCredentialsRepository staffCredentialsRepository, StaffSessionRepository staffSessionRepository)
      Constructs a new AuthService with the specified dependencies.
      Parameters:
      clientRepository - the repository for managing client entities
      credentialsRepository - the repository for managing client credentials
      passwordEncoder - the password encoder for verifying client passwords
      jwtService - the service for generating JWT tokens
      sessionRepository - the repository for client login sessions
      staffCredentialsRepository - the repository for staff sign-in credentials
      staffSessionRepository - the repository for staff login sessions

  • Method Details

    • authenticate

      @Transactional(noRollbackFor={InvalidCredentialsException.class,AccountLockedException.class}) public LoginResponse authenticate(String email, String rawPassword)
      Authenticates a client using their email and password.
      Parameters:
      email - the email of the client attempting to authenticate
      rawPassword - the raw password provided by the client
      Returns:
      a LoginResponse containing the authentication token and related information
      Throws:
      InvalidCredentialsException - if the email or password is incorrect
      AccountLockedException - if the account is locked due to too many failed login attempts
